criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: Clear need, users and functions identified with 4 references. No explicit quantified objectives/requirements. Referencing is URLs only and mission success criteria vague, so top of Adequate not Accomplished.

evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: Gantt with dated tasks and descriptions shows feasible path to 20/11/20 with review provision. No explicit list of planned information sources and limited contingency justification, so lacks Accomplished detail.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Only background reading and generic STK tutorials, no mission-specific results, plots or calculations. Orbit choice is fundamentally wrong, showing insufficient technical understanding to date.

evidence.quote: My current choice is a geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Logical headings, fluent writing, consistent formatting. Gantt is labelled and explained. Footnote URLs match text but informal style and minor schedule inconsistency prevent higher mark.

evidence.quote: Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue

technical_issues.issue: Geostationary orbit at 600 km is impossible: GEO ~35786 km equatorial; 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed over non-equatorial Great Barrier Reef.

overall: Good reef-monitoring concept with users and plan, but minimal mission-specific analysis and major orbit error limit progress. Presentation clear.

feedback.summary: You presented a clear Great Barrier Reef monitoring concept with well-identified users and a readable plan with Gantt chart. To progress, you need quantified requirements, proper references, mission-specific analysis, and to correct your impossible 600 km geostationary orbit to reach the Accomplished levels.
next_steps: Quantify your mission objectives and success criteria in Mission Concept & Rationale and replace URL footnotes with proper literature citations linking functions to user needs.
Correct your orbit choice in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress — 600 km cannot be geostationary — and add mission-specific STK plots and calculations for coverage over the Reef.
Expand your Gantt-based plan to list information sources and software and explain contingencies showing why tasks fit your reef-monitoring narrative.

criteria.C1: In Mission Concept & Rationale you clearly described need and users, e.g. your near-real-time relay for scientists to predict bleaching, supported by 4 references. For Accomplished you need explicit quantified goals, objectives, requirements and success criteria clearly linked to user needs with proper literature citations, not URLs only.
criteria.C2: In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress your Gantt chart with dated tasks to 20/11/20 shows a feasible path with review provision. For Accomplished you need a robust plan explaining why tasks fit your reef-monitoring narrative, justifying contingencies, and listing planned information sources.
criteria.C3: In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress you completed background reading and STK tutorials 1-4, which shows effort. For Accomplished you need mission-specific results with description and interpretation showing you are on track, and you must correct your geostationary orbit at 600 km, which is impossible for Reef coverage.
criteria.C4: Your report uses clear logical headings, fluent writing and consistent formatting, and your Gantt is labelled and explained e.g. Completed stages are gold. To strengthen your Accomplished presentation, use formal citation style throughout and check schedule consistency.
